heroHeading: Where exceptional dog care *leads the way*
heroLead: Day care, home boarding, walking, training and grooming on the Surrey–Hampshire border. Our team are experts in canine behaviour and body language, which means safer handling, better social experiences and a higher standard of care for every dog.
ratingText: Trusted by local dog owners for over 10 years
floatCardText: Your introductory meeting and assessment costs nothing
servicesHeading: Everything your dog needs, all in one place
servicesIntro: Day care, holidays, walks, training and grooming, plus cat sitting and wedding days. Professional, trusted care built around your dog's wellbeing.
whyHeading: We don't follow industry standards. We set them.
whyIntro: We've built a community of dog owners and animal lovers who value professionalism, reliability and a genuine passion for dogs. We support local charities and community events too.
howIntro: Three simple steps, starting with a free introductory meeting.
areasIntro: Our day care service covers the areas below. Dog walking covers Ash, Aldershot, North Camp, Farnborough and Mytchett. Not sure if we cover you? Just ask.
areaCardText: Our day care team collect and return your dog in secure, professionally fitted dog vans.
